subject: Alfred Street Cease and Desist Order Enforcement
overview: The Council addressed neighborhood complaints regarding ongoing industrial work at 9 Alfred Street, voting to demand stricter enforcement of a cease and desist order and schedule an emergency meeting. Other business included requests for updates on snow removal plans, soil contamination testing at school fields, and the membership of the Green Line Extension committee.

items.title: Alfred Street Industrial Activity Violations
items.summary: Approved motions requesting an all-hours cease and desist order for 9 Alfred Street, a legal opinion on permit transferability, and an emergency meeting to address complaints of ongoing industrial work in a residential zone.

items.title: Snow Storage and Wright's Pond Residency
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting updates on snow storage locations and a legal opinion on whether accepting a grant for Wright's Pond would require the city to open the pond to non-residents.

items.title: Andrews School Test Boring Results
items.summary: Approved a request for an update on test boring results and soil contamination remediation for the land abutting the Andrews Middle School soccer fields.

items.title: Handicapped Parking Compliance at Wegmans
items.summary: Approved a request for the Office of Diversity and Inclusion to assess if handicapped parking at the new Wegmans facility complies with city ordinances.

items.title: Property Maintenance at 101 George P. Hassett Drive
items.summary: Approved a request for the administration to ensure open windows at the property are boarded up and to provide a development timetable from the owner.

items.title: FY2018 Real Estate Tax Allocation Report
items.summary: Accepted the report of the Committee of the Whole regarding the fiscal year 2018 real estate tax allocation.

items.title: Condolences and Routine Business
items.summary: Offered condolences to the family of Joanne Abbott and rescheduled several signage reviews for the January 9, 2018, meeting.

items.title: Green Line Extension Committee Composition
items.summary: Approved a motion requesting that the Mayor expand the Green Line Extension committee and reconsider reappointing community members who served during the project's first phase.

items.title: Zoning Amendment Public Hearing Notice
items.summary: Announced a February 7, 2018, public hearing concerning expanded abutter notifications and approved a motion for a reverse 9-1-1 call to notify the public.
